title: [Bug]: quoting an option hides chmod 777 / chown -R / kill -9 from the bypass-immune safety check
body: Opened #3859 with a fix: the pattern check now also runs against the command with shell quoting removed, so quoted spellings of `chmod 777`, `chmod -R 777`, `chown -R`, `kill -9`, `rm -rf`, `sudo rm` …
